content:
We've already heard that the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra may drop both its 3x telephoto camera and its laser autofocus module. Today a tipster on X claims there's some good news too, with the new main camera having significantly improved the brightness and detail in night photography. The video quality is reportedly particularly impressive too.
That's all the tipster shared this time, and there are no samples to go with the claim. According to previous leaks, the upcoming Ultra is expected to use a 200MP main camera, a 50MP ultrawide, and a 50MP 5x telephoto, compared to the four-camera setup on the Galaxy S26 Ultra. An earlier leak already pointed to smoother, less noisy images in low light, so this latest tip lines up with that. The phone is expected to launch in early 2027 so there's still time for plenty of other leaks and rumors about it to appear in the coming weeks. Stay tuned.
